count_formula: ceil(target_ns*probe_iterations/probe_cpu_ns), clamp [256,1000000] local or [512,65536] search; reject predicted outside250ms..1s or probe below100us
single_process_scope: Existing account wrapper and its one native child retain same owned session/group. No escaped-child/cgroup theorem; failure to confirm group disappearance/reap within5s invalidates and stops.
reference_ratios: descriptive cross-host/artifact local and enclosing scopes only; no inner search ratio, subtraction, conversion, qualification or gate
